name: Stormbringer: Storm Barrier shields the caster while Lightning Cage is active (#3112)
contract: #3112: Storm Barrier 707204 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 22, Attributes 448 = PASSIVE|DO_NOT_DISPLAY|DO_NOT_LOG) promises 'While Lightning Cage is active your Magic Damage taken is now reduced by $s1% and you are unable to be hit by ranged attacks.'. Its two effects are aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) and 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), EffectBasePoints -26 and -101 with DieSides 1, i.e. flat -25 and -100, both scoped to EffectSpellClassMask[2]/[5] = 134217728 (family 22, dword 2, bit 27). A full Spell.dbc scan for SpellFamilyName 22 with SpellFamilyFlags[2] bit 27 returns exactly one row: 560032 Lightning Cage rank 'SLS' (AttributesEx 268435456 = SPELL_ATTR1_NO_AURA_ICON, DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms), whose effect 0 is aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN on misc 126 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_MAGIC) and effect 1 is aura 185 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_RANGED_HIT_CHANCE, both with EffectBasePoints -1 and DieSides 1, i.e. amount 0. Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10325) resolves those zeros to basevalue * 1 + flat = -25 and -100 (the null-basevalue guard at Player.cpp:10258 skips percent mods only). Nothing in the server ever applied 560032: it has no CharacterAdvancement row, no SkillLineAbility, no module grant and no trigger, and the spell the player actually casts is 560030 Lightning Cage (SpellFamilyFlags[2] = 33554432, bit 25, DurationIndex 9 = 30000 ms, all three effects on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER), which carries no damage-taken or ranged-hit effect of its own. The fix registers aura_ascension_lightning_cage on 560030: while the cage is up on a player who knows 707204, the hidden companion 560032 is applied to that player with the cage's own duration, so Storm Barrier's modifiers have something to modify. Expected numbers: spell_effect_value on 560032 effect 0 = -25 and effect 1 = -100 (this layer already read correctly before the fix and proves the DBC reading); spell_damage_taken with Shock 804020 (SchoolMask 8 = Nature, inside misc 126) falls to 1000 * (1 - 25/100) = 750, ratio 0.75, while Heroic Strike 78 (SchoolMask 1 = Physical, outside misc 126) stays at 1.0. The ranged-hit clause is covered through the effect-value layer only: the harness has no attacker-side ranged-miss metric, and the -100 to 105% miss conversion is core-native at Unit.cpp:3977-3978.
